import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class HungarianMatching {
    static final int SIZE = 2000;
    int cnt,[] pos = new int[SIZE], rev = new int[SIZE];
    int[] v = new int[SIZE];

    public int gao(int n, List<Integer>[] e){
        cnt=0;
        Arrays.fill(pos, -1);
        Arrays.fill(rev, -1);
        for(int i=0; i<n; i++){
            Arrays.fill(v,0);
            if(match(i,e)) cnt++;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    private boolean match(int x, List<Integer>[] e){
        for(int y : e[x]){
            if(v[y]==0){
                v[y]=1;
                if(rev[y]==-1 || match(rev[y], e)){
                    pos[x]=y;
                    rev[y]=x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

public class Main {
    static final int INF=1000000000;
    static final int[] mr={0,-1,0,1};
    static final int[] mc={1,0,-1,0};

    static int[][] a = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] b = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] f = new int[12][12];
    static int m,t;
    static List<Integer>[] e = new ArrayList[2000];
    static List<Integer>[][] c = new ArrayList[12][12];

    static {
        for(int i=0; i<2000; i++) e[i]=new ArrayList<>();
        for(int i=0; i<12; i++) for(int j=0; j<12; j++) c[i][j]=new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static void floodfill(int sr, int sc){
        int[][] dist = new int[12][12];
        for(int[] row : dist)
            Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        qr.offer(sr);
        qc.offer(sc);
        f[sr][sc]=0;
        while(!qr.isEmpty()){
            int r = qr.poll();
            int c_ = qc.poll();
            for(int i=0; i<4; i++){
                int tr = r + mr[i];
                int tc = c_ + mc[i];
                if(a[tr][tc]>=0 && f[tr][tc]<0){
                    f[tr][tc]=f[r][c_]+1;
                    qr.offer(tr);
                    qc.offer(tc);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void setmark(int sr, int sc, int cnt) {
        int[][] v = new int[12][12];
        for(int[] row: v) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        qr.offer(sr);
        qc.offer(sc);
        v[sr][sc]=0;

        while(!qr.isEmpty()){
            int r = qr.poll();
            int c_ = qc.poll();

            if(v[r][c_]> Math.min(t,f[r][c_])) continue;

            for(int j=0; j<c[r][c_].size(); j++){
                int node = c[r][c_].get(j);
                for(int i=0; i<cnt; i++){
                    e[m+i].add(node);
                }
            }

            if(v[r][c_]==Math.min(t,f[r][c_])) continue;

            for(int i=0; i<4; i++){
                int tr=r+mr[i];
                int tc=c_+mc[i];
                if(a[tr][tc]>=0 && v[tr][tc]<0){
                    v[tr][tc]=v[r][c_]+1;
                    qr.offer(tr);
                    qc.offer(tc);
                }
            }
        }
        m+=cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer tk = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(tk.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(tk.nextToken());
        for(int i=0; i<12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(a[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(b[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(f[i], -1);
        }
        int sr=0, sc=0, o=0, index=0;
        for(int i=1; i<=n; i++){
            String line;
            while((line=br.readLine())==null || line.isEmpty());
            char[] rowChars = line.toCharArray();
            int j=0;
            for(int j2=0; j2<rowChars.length; j2++){
                char ch=rowChars[j2];
                if(j2>=rowChars.length) break;
                if(ch>='0' && ch<='9') a[i][j]=ch-'0';
                if(ch=='Z') {
                    sr=i;
                    sc=j;
                }
                j++;
            }
        }
        floodfill(sr, sc);
        for(int i=1; i<=n; i++){
            String line;
            while((line=br.readLine())==null || line.isEmpty());
            char[] rowChars = line.toCharArray();
            int j=0;
            for(int j2=0; j2<rowChars.length; j2++){
                char ch=rowChars[j2];
                if(ch>='0' && ch<='9') b[i][j]=ch-'0';
                for(int k=0; k<b[i][j]; k++) c[i][j].add(o++);
                j++;
            }
        }
        for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for(int j=1; j<=n; j++)
                if(f[i][j]<0) f[i][j]=INF;
        for(int i=1; i<=n; i++)
            for(int j=1; j<=n; j++)
                if(a[i][j]>0) setmark(i,j,a[i][j]);
        HungarianMatching matchObj = new HungarianMatching();
        int result = matchObj.gao(m, e);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
